description: This source file defines the VisitUnvoidHandler class responsible for unvoiding Visit objects and associated Encounters in the OpenMRS system. It implements the UnvoidHandler interface, providing the handle method which unvoids encounters linked to a visit based on specific conditions.

classes.name: VisitUnvoidHandler
classes.description: A handler that unvoids a Visit and its related Encounters when called.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Unvoids encounters associated with a visit if they meet specific void conditions.
